name: agent-blackboard
description: Local Agent Blackboard for Lead task observability, structured wakeup reminders, event watching, and a compact task-lane view.

interface.shortDescription: Observe Pi Agent task activity by Lead task ID
interface.longDescription: Lead-owned local task lanes for observing explicit Pi Team activity, blockers, review state, and current scope without turning the Blackboard into a control bus.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the Agent Blackboard for the current project and watch for new Pi Agent activity.
